confidences.reason: At step 2, the agent began with an arXiv-only search using very generic queries and did not use the Bing/web search capability or try to identify authors to refine results. This diverges from the agent’s described strength (Bing-based retrieval) and likely hindered discovery, so the claim that this was a mistake is supported by the log.

The log shows the agent immediately used arXiv’s internal search with vague queries and never pivoted to identify exact titles/authors via broader web search, despite needing specific papers from given months. This constrained strategy persisted through repeated arXiv-only queries and led to failure. No earlier step constituted a clearer mistake, so step 2’s approach is plausibly the first misstep that drove the wrong outcome.

The log shows repeated use of arxiv_search with slight query variations and no pivot to web search, author identification, or alternative databases. Even when the Verification_Expert stepped in, they repeated the same arXiv query. Thus, the initial strategy error was not corrected.
Step 2 exists in the log and its agent is 'InformationExtraction_Expert'.
